ranked_facts.concept_key: loud single S2 with bounding pulses and wide pulse pressure
ranked_facts.why: The presence of a loud single S2 with bounding pulses and wide pulse pressure is more consistent with left heart obstructive lesions, such as those found in B1, rather than right heart obstructive lesions like those in B3, because it suggests increased pulmonary flow and pressure, which is less characteristic of right-sided obstructive lesions.

Cardiomegaly with increased pulmonary vascularity is more indicative of a cardiac cause, such as left heart obstructive lesions in B1, rather than non-cardiac causes in B5, because it directly points to cardiac pathology affecting pulmonary circulation.
